raw: {"analysis": "BGN incorrectly suggests returning 200 for write attempts to satisfy health checks, conflating write endpoints with the health endpoint, which could mislead clients and risk rollback. SCX correctly separates health check (always 200 if process up) from write endpoints (return 423), and proactively toggles the flag before deployment to account for propagation delay, ensuring read-only mode is active when code goes live. SCX also provides a config fallback and clearer timing, making it more robust.", "verdict": "SCX"}
